sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Reda is one of the new characters added to the 3rd storyline arc of Brave Frontier debuting in the world of Bectas. She is a Summoner from the Akras Summoners' Hall and one of the new companions of the Summoner and Tilith in their mission to find and restore the Sealed Gods back to normal.

'''Reda''' is one of the new characters added to the 3rd storyline arc of Brave Frontier debuting in the world of Bectas. She is a Summoner from the Akras Summoners' Hall and one of the new companions of the Summoner and Tilith in their mission to find and restore the Sealed Gods back to normal.
